title: Crop Insurance Indemnity Payment and Assignment Terms by Plan and Coverage Level
content:
Crop Insurance indemnities are paid on the same terms at every plan and coverage level, and at every level they may be assigned to the association as lender.

| Plan and coverage level | Paid within, after the claim is finalized | Minimum indemnity payable | Assignment of indemnity to a lender | Unpaid premium and fees deducted before payment | Payee when an assignment is on file |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Catastrophic Risk Protection (CAT) | 30 calendar days | $0.00 | allowed | Yes | the member and the association jointly |
| Revenue Protection 65% Coverage | 30 calendar days | $0.00 | allowed | Yes | the member and the association jointly |
| Revenue Protection 70% Coverage | 30 calendar days | $0.00 | allowed | Yes | the member and the association jointly |
| Revenue Protection 75% Coverage | 30 calendar days | $0.00 | allowed | Yes | the member and the association jointly |
| Revenue Protection 80% Coverage | 30 calendar days | $0.00 | allowed | Yes | the member and the association jointly |
| Revenue Protection 85% Coverage | 30 calendar days | $0.00 | allowed | Yes | the member and the association jointly |

Column meanings:

- **Paid within** — Calendar days after a claim is finalized by which the indemnity is paid.
- **Minimum indemnity payable** — Indemnities below this amount are not paid, USD.
- **Assignment** — whether the indemnity may be assigned to a lender.
- **Deduction before payment** — whether unpaid premium and fees are deducted from an indemnity before payment.
- **Payee** — Payee of an indemnity when an assignment is on file.

Reading the table:

- With a minimum of $0.00 at every level, no positive indemnity falls below the minimum indemnity payable.
- The 30 days are calendar days counted from the date the claim is finalized: for a claim finalized on a hypothetical November 20, payment is due by December 20.
- On an assigned policy at any level, the indemnity is paid to the member and the association jointly; at every level, unpaid premium and fees come out of the indemnity before it is paid.
